theorems.statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m) (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Rn (m + k)) (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ Φ.source → InjOn ψ Φ.source → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ Φ.source → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ.symm Φ.target → (∀ u ∈ Φ.source, (Φ u).fst = G u) → ∀ B ⊆ Φ.source, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ u in B, φ (ψ u) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).normDet) = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume
